skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the basic concepts of public finance, the role of government in the economy, and the tools of public finance policy.
Grasp the nature, role, and contents of the state budget, budget balance, and budget management.
Comprehend the concepts, characteristics, and structures of taxation.
Understand the concepts, significance, and objectives of public debt management.
Develop research, analysis, and synthesis skills to address public finance issues.
Establish critical thinking in evaluating public finance issues.
Demonstrate teamwork skills, collaboration, and information sharing.
Apply professional knowledge to analyze real-world issues and propose solutions.
Effectively present analysis results and engage in discussions.
